responsibility: Implements the AVR backend’s internal debug logging facility controlled by `-mlog=`. The file provides the `avr_vdump`/`avr_fdump` machinery and a custom mini-format language for printing RTL, trees, locations, pass information, register classes, and other backend state to dump streams or stderr, and it parses the selected logging categories into the global `avr_log` flags that other AVR backend code uses to gate detailed tracing.
